verdict.rationale: Gide Loyrette Nouel is a law firm. A firm could plausibly offer clients a digital platform with an AI assistant, so the axis applies. The only AI-related evidence says the firm uses AI internally to optimise its own services. Nothing shows a client-facing, built-in assistant that users can delegate tasks to, so this is adjacent support at most.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
